sinopsis.es: En el bar Babel se mezclan vivos y muertos. Dante busca recordar su pasado antes de que la Flaca, la Muerte, cobre su deuda. Jacob oculta su deseo de ser drag queen a su padre, cura fanático; Uma, gitana con apuesta propia, intenta engañar a la Flaca para salvar a su hija. Entre pactos y desafíos, sus destinos chocan en lucha contra lo inevitable.
sinopsis.en: At the Babel bar, living and dead mingle. Dante tries to recall his past before la Flaca, Death, collects his debt. Jacob hides his wish to be a drag queen from his fanatical priest father. Uma, a Gypsy with her own wager, tries to trick la Flaca to save her daughter. Amid pacts and challenges, their fates collide in a fight against the inevitable.
